summary: Hawkish US backdrop: Q3 GDP 3.4% and PCE inflation 3.6% after the Fed held at 3.75-4.00% with two hike dissents; Alphabet -12.6% dragged the Nasdaq 1.4% and Amazon/Intel fell after hours. BOJ decides today.
events_next_24h: Fri ~13:00-14:00 JPY BOJ policy decision (no fixed time)
Fri ~17:30 JPY BOJ Governor press conference
Fri pre-US-open ExxonMobil and AbbVie earnings
tier1_next_14d: BOJ policy decision · Fri, 30 Oct, ~13:00-14:00 (unconfirmed time)

ES.why: Hot PCE inflation and 84% odds of a December Fed hike weigh; S&P slipped 0.3% and Amazon fell ~7% after hours. Funds positioning neutral.
ES.risk: Strong ECI-free tape or Amazon/Apple bounce lifts megacaps back.

NQ.why: Alphabet -12.6% sank Nasdaq 1.4%; Amazon and Intel fell hard after hours with 10y near 5%. Funds crowded long (94th pct) adds downside fuel.
NQ.risk: Dip-buying in AI names or a sharp drop in yields.

YM.why: Dow dipped ~0.4% but health care hit records; hawkish Fed weighs yet Dow is less exposed to the big-tech earnings selloff.
YM.risk: Broad risk-off spills into value names.

RTY.why: Small caps rose ~1% against the tech drop, but 5% 10-year yields and hike odds usually hurt them; signals conflict.
RTY.risk: Yields jump further after ECI, or rotation out of tech accelerates.

NKD.why: BOJ decides today and Tokyo CPI is out this morning; US tech weakness weighs, but funds lean short (22nd pct), so a hold could spark a bounce.
NKD.risk: Hawkish BOJ surprise (hike) lifts yen and hits Nikkei.

6E.why: EUR/USD flat near 1.113; hawkish Fed supports the dollar but no clear euro catalyst found overnight.
6E.risk: Fresh euro-area inflation surprise or dollar breakout.

6J.why: BOJ decision today: a hawkish hold is expected; USD/JPY near 158 keeps intervention risk alive. Tier-1 event could flip it.
6J.risk: BOJ hike or explicit intervention warning sends yen sharply higher.

6B.why: No clear UK catalyst found overnight; dollar firm on Fed hike odds but sterling move not confirmed.
6B.risk: Strong dollar move after US ECI data.

6A.why: Risk tone mixed (tech down, small caps up) and no Australian catalyst found; Aussie lacks a clear driver today.

ZN.why: PCE inflation sped up to 3.6% and GDP hit 3.4%; two Fed officials wanted a hike and the 10-year yield rose to ~5.05%.
ZN.risk: Soft Employment Cost Index tonight eases hike fears.

GC.why: Gold slid toward $4,000 as hot growth and inflation keep a December hike in play; funds lean short (24th pct), limiting the edge.
GC.risk: Middle East flare-up or dollar drop revives safe-haven buying.

CL.why: Middle East/Hormuz supply risk keeps oil supported, but I couldn't verify overnight settlement moves; funds lean short (13th pct) = squeeze fuel.
CL.risk: Confirmed supply disruption (bullish) or de-escalation news (bearish).
